title: Enzymes and Physiological Conditions
purpose: Explain enzyme function and effects of pH and temperature.
required_visual_model_data: Enzyme activity graph; condition comparison table

direct_resource.Title: OpenStax Biology 2e: Enzymes
direct_resource.Task: Click the link and use the enzyme section. Observe how enzymes change reaction rate and how conditions affect function. Record substrate, active site, enzyme activity, and one condition that can reduce activity.

mastery_rule: Student can explain the lesson standard with structure-function reasoning and visual/data evidence.
